name: Costello for U.S. Senate
subject: Maine’s Primary Election is a Week Away
body:
Maine’s US Senate race is not settled...

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/ioX567oBgt0?e=5d7176e969&c2id=0715660f99493bd2d61bdbd7e3d6dd36)
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/iVAxU2wiN90?e=5d7176e969&c2id=0715660f99493bd2d61bdbd7e3d6dd36)
| | | | | | | | | | | |
Friends,Maine’s US Senate race is not settled! Anything can, and often does, happen overnight in politics. With Maine’s Democratic primary taking place in a week, we’re ramping up efforts to let more Maine voters know that David is very much in the race. And, as summarized in the BDN Op Ed below, David has the most fitting background, knowledge, and experience to not only defeat Senator Susan Collins in November, but to also help in advancing real, substantive change in Washington.And, for those interested, we’ve scheduled another virtual Town Hall with David for tomorrow evening 7PM – 8PM. To RSVP: [https://www.costelloforsenate.com/event-details/virtual-town-hall-with-us-senate-candidate-david-costello-4](https://us.list-manage.com/__2gNKupbaL?e=5d7176e969&c2id=0715660f99493bd2d61bdbd7e3d6dd36) _**Bangor Daily News Op Ed**_**: Experience should matter in Maine’s Senate primary (by David Costello)** While many, including most in the press, have essentially [declared](https://us.list-manage.com/NJBD0ujaDWu?e=5d7176e969&c2id=0715660f99493bd2d61bdbd7e3d6dd36) Maine’s Democratic U.S. Senate primary over, there’s still time for voters to consider whether the Democratic Party’s presumptive nominee is the best person to take on Sen. Susan Collins in November. Perceptions of political viability can, and often do, change overnight.
I believe that my personal story, education, and government experience contrasts more sharply with that of Sen. Collins than does Graham Platner’s. My lived experience is rooted in many of the same challenges working-class Mainers face every day, and my extensive government service is broader, deeper and more hands-on than Sen. Collins’. Moreover, I believe that my experiences equip me with the kind of knowledge and perspective sorely needed in Washington today.
I was born in Bangor and raised in Old Town by my mother and mill-working grandparents. My father, an Army veteran and labor organizer, died at the age of 31 due to hazardous working conditions he faced as a teenager. I know what it’s like to have to hustle to pay bills, compile years of debt and go long periods without health insurance and healthcare.
Like many in Maine, I began working at an early age and worked my way through the University of Maine, George Washington University and the London School of Economics. And I subsequently served for more than 30 years in senior-level government and non-governmental organization positions, both in the United States and abroad.
These positions included serving as a top aide to Maine’s secretary of state, the mayor of Baltimore and governor of Maryland; as a deputy and acting secretary of the Maryland Department of the Environment; and as a county program manager and regional team leader for the United States Agency for International Development (USAID). These positions involved implementing and managing, not simply legislating or talking about, complex multimillion-dollar programs and operations.
These programs and operations included working closely with the U.S. Army, State Department, United Nations and foreign aid organizations overseas — and various state and local government agencies, businesses and non-governmental organizations in Maine, Maryland and elsewhere.
They are programs and operations that resulted in election and motor vehicle safety reforms in Maine; improved schools and family assistance programs in Baltimore; the implementation of ambitious job creation, education, healthcare, crime reduction and environmental protection programs in Maryland; and the completion of more than 3,500 peace and community-building projects in conflict-torn Cambodia, Haiti, Bosnia, Croatia, Kosovo and Serbia.
I believe experience matters, but so too does my decades-long commitment to substantially reforming our nation’s governing policies, practices, and institutions and eliminating the excessive and corrupting influence that money, wealth and disinformation have over our politics and government. Like many Democrats, I am fully committed to enacting far-reaching legislative and constitutional reforms, among them: Medicare for All; universal childcare; expanded Social Security benefits; a national minimum living wage; increased taxes on the wealthy; a ban on gerrymandering; federal clean elections financing; comprehensive immigration reform; judicial and legislative term limits; codification of Roe v. Wade; an assault weapons ban; and an aggressive national climate action plan.
Reforms designed to not only salvage our democracy, but to also better protect our rights and freedoms and to enable us to finally tackle such pressing challenges as: unaffordable housing and healthcare; insufficient retirement security; economic inequality; gun violence; shoddy infrastructure; and climate change. Because only then are we likely to achieve the more perfect union envisioned by our most thoughtful founders and forebears.
As always, please aid in our efforts by sharing this email with friends, family and colleagues.
Thank you,Team Costello

A humbling message...

A humbling message...
| Friend,
---
I'm truly humbled and honored.
---
Direct from the White House, my friend President Trump said:

**" JIM JORDAN IS A VERY GOOD FRIEND, FIGHTER, AND WINNER... HE WILL _NEVER_ LET YOU DOWN"**
---
[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkM2OnDAQhJ_G3ED-Bw4-bIS4bRRFkfaITLtnxgk2yG6yrx8xmjzAXr-qLnXVx_vy7uMW8_27T-gK3ZZSF3rgUbDGgJlqJU-YMNMiubQtty0Xl0k0wQUIXkCDTvQDV0poMzQPJ1DcRlxHqeRgtNWrDr0B3g8adQAfmuiuKG65EFZxYzpvAMyqbZCggxqBae43LNQVPM51i-Az-frnthfADvbUbO5BdFSm3picmZwrwlmw-4y5YLgcTM6EPrW_9xJ8ZnIOOIggOR9XgbgKdd2p-aS0gE-Hj_fM1PR8y0jBpL2UhCGeiakJk4_bCxIwNf38Nbf_O7x43c8CeGkfy7cXgz0TZmJq-vHWFBeOz7htsdqeaX6_Mp9l6Iu7_3XyXwAAAP__2haNmA)

Coming from the President, those are powerful words.

President Trump knows _better than anyone_ the fight I'm waging to drain the swamp and put power back where it belongs - with _YOU_ , the American people.
---
Look, I know talk is cheap in politics. Anyone can make a promise. Anyone can say they'll fight.
---
**But I 've got the receipts to back it up**. I've been sued. I've been spied on. My phone records were seized. And the Left only attacks me, because I fight for YOU.
---
**I 'm working with the President - _behind the scenes and all hours of the day_ - to deliver on the agenda you voted for.**
---
And directly from the Oval Office, President Trump laid out the agenda **WE** are fighting for:
---
_**✅Grow our economy
✅Cut taxes
✅Slash burdensome regulations
✅Promote Made-In-The-USA products
✅Champion American energy dominance
✅Keep our border secure
✅Stop migrant crime
✅Defend your constitutional rights
✅Stopping the Radical Left ** _
---
And in just a few months, that same agenda will be voted on AGAIN in the midterm elections.
---
There's been a lot of doom and gloom about our odds of holding the House. But truth be told, Democrats now ONLY have a **2-POINT** advantage over us.
---
And that's not because voters suddenly approve of Radical Left ideas._It 's simply because our side isn't showing up to vote._
---
**If 2% more Republicans show up, we can EASILY erase the Democrats ' 2-point lead. This is a problem we can absolutely fix.**
---
_So, we are going zip code by zip code in our voter file to determine where we need more participation._
---
Friend, we've crunched the numbers and with our razor-thin majority now within the margin of error, YOUR voter profile in your zip code is the difference maker.
---
_That 's why I'm reaching out today to simply ask that you VERIFY your GOP voter profile to give me and President Trump the most accurate polling possible to ERASE the Democrats' 2% LEAD over us._
---

---

[VERIFY NOW ](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkU2O2zAMhU8j7xJIlKXECy-mMLyboigKzNKgRSZRa8mGRHeuXzhIDzBLfu_x54Ef79M7xiXm-3dM3Be5TaVO8uCtcI3EWWoVFE6cZQIN_qT9SZvDZBrqKRCa0HBvLldtrWndtXn0HgDM5eKd6QiR3MyGyTtD-kbUcdfE_hilvTbGW-3cGV0Ibm49QWjJdkG1Ghcuci687fMSA2bB-ue2lsDnsKZm6R8iW1X2TcGoYKwc9sLnz5gL0-FQMApjOv1eC2FWMBJfDYHW3WyYZ2OPPjvukqaAacN4z8oOz7McGAX-UBJT3JOyAyeMywtKUHb4-Ws8_c_w4nXdS-BD-5i-vVhYs3AWZYcfbwo8pnV_VuCa0tP2GZclVn9Rrb4fG57R5Itf-NvDvwAAAP__tSmR6A)

**June 1, 2026** **MONDAY NEWS DIGEST**
| | Dear Rocky Mountain Voice family,
One of the most important questions in politics is often the simplest:
**Who's funding it?**
This week, RMV published a deep-dive investigation into the [organization behind the campaign opposing Erin Lee's ballot initiatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) headed to Colorado voters this November. The committee is called _Families Not Politics_.
It presents itself as a grassroots effort focused on protecting families. But according to campaign finance records reviewed by RMV, nearly 90% of its funding comes not from Colorado parents, but from a **coalition of established political organizations** —including a Planned Parenthood affiliate, an abortion-rights group, an Oregon-based PAC, and One Colorado, the organization behind Colorado's statewide [Gender and Sexuality Alliance (GSA) network](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
The story gets even more interesting when you follow the timeline.
Years before launching her ballot initiatives, Erin Lee was [fighting Poudre School District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over concerns involving a school GSA club and the role outside organizations played in guiding those programs. Records obtained by RMV show that One Colorado was repeatedly identified by district officials as a resource used by GSA clubs operating within the district.
Today, that same organization is [providing nearly $100,000 in campaign infrastructure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to help defeat Lee's ballot initiatives.
Whether you support or oppose the measures themselves, we believe voters deserve transparency. Who is involved. Who is funding the campaigns. And who is shaping the messages they'll see between now and November.
That's one reason we're especially excited to welcome Erin Lee to the Freedom Fest main stage on Friday, June 26!
Few Coloradans have had a bigger impact on the conversation around parental rights, transparency, and the role of schools in recent years. Her story ultimately sparked a movement that has now produced three statewide ballot initiatives headed before voters this November. And she's just one of the incredible speakers joining us.
**🇺🇸[Freedom Festival is only 25 DAYS AWAY!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** Over two unforgettable days, we'll celebrate America's 250th birthday and Colorado's 150th birthday with some of the most influential voices in the country.
🔥 Greg Gutfeld
🔥 Lara Logan

...and many more.
Plus: 🎶 Live music
🤠 Rodeo events

---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132506436/624745970/1307130675?refcode=WUEFHR01_20260601_HinojosaSplit_ALL_v1s2&sourceid=1058957&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYmE2YTBmOC1kYjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=f6dVnLoq6ZEXj0WZE1lLv6EpdexkMmP6tyqwE0UNSos=) The Texas U.S. Senate race is officially set, Peter.

**Texas Republicans are heading into November with Greg Abbott and Ken Paxton.**

And now, we’re moving into the next phase of this fight with one mission in mind — **ending the era of corruption and negligence Texans have been living under for _far too long._**

Abbott and Paxton have built their careers on putting their mega donors and political games first and Texas families last. And after years of their leadership, we have nothing to show for it.

Right now, Texan families are suffering with higher costs. Public schools are severely underfunded. We have a healthcare crisis that has millions of Texas children uninsured. And a government that’s more concerned with holding power than solving problems.

clean_body: Help defeat Abbott and Ken Paxton in November. | = The Texas U.S. Senate race is officially set, Peter. Texas Republicans are heading into November with Greg Abbott and Ken Paxton. And now, we’re moving into the next phase of this fight with one mission in mind — ending the era of corruption and negligence Texans have been living under for far too long. Abbott and Paxton have built their careers on putting their mega donors and political games first and Texas families last. And after years of their leadership, we have nothing to show for it. Right now, Texan families are suffering with higher costs. Public schools are severely underfunded. We have a healthcare crisis that has millions of Texas children uninsured. And a government that’s more concerned with holding power than solving problems. That’s why I am building something different. body:
Growing up I never imagined this future was possible.
#
Folks, Chris Pappas here. **Happy Pride!** 🏳️🌈
So much has changed since I was a kid. I remember hearing so much derogatory language used against gay people — some directed at me before I even knew who I was.
When I came out in college, I was lucky to have a family that supported me unconditionally. More and more Granite Staters ascribe to a live-and-let-live philosophy. They want their neighbors to be able to live freely and be who they are. That’s why **New Hampshire was one of the first states to support marriage equality.**
But the Trump Administration has been relentlessly attacking the LGBTQ+ community – taking away vital mental health resources and supporting discriminatory laws. I’m running for Senate to represent all Granite Staters — and while, if elected, I would be the first out gay man in the Senate, this campaign is about fighting for everyone.
We’re going to lower costs, protect health care access, and stand up to a reckless administration that’s coming after everyone. It would be an honor to have you by my side — and since I don’t rely on corporate PACs, **I need your help to make history.**
**[Will you help me make history and stand up for the Granite State? Pitch in $5 to support my grassroots campaign.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260601_1.c6L_Fv&refcode=em20260601-1&t=1&akid=6954%2E582294%2ERXutMM)**

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. # 🚨BREAKING🚨:
Anthropic files IPO Prospectus Ahead of OpenAI
AI company Anthropic, makers of the "Claude" AI model confidentially **[filed its IPO prospectus with the SEC on Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/831de606-3cba-4c65-b46a-f64fe4564bd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , positioning it ahead of rival OpenAI. The move gives the option to go public after SEC review, depending on market conditions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/831de606-3cba-4c65-b46a-f64fe4564bd6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Confidential IPO Filing Submitted:** Anthropic **[announced the filing](https://substack.com/redirect/26a43793-555e-4cf1-b2c3-f9709a38de9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which provides the option to go public after the SEC completes its review, with the proposed initial public offering depending on market conditions and other factors.
* **Record Valuation Surpasses OpenAI:** The company closed a funding round at a $965 billion valuation after raising $65 billion, topping OpenAI which was valued at $852 billion in March.
* **Revenue Run Rate Ballooned:** Anthropic's revenue run rate ballooned to $47 billion this year, up from $10 billion in annual revenue last year.
* **Claude Models Power Growth:** The AI firm is best known for its Claude family of AI models, which power products like the popular coding assistant Claude Code.

# [Nvidia to spend billions on revolutionary power transfer system](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia has committed at least $6.5 billion to **[photonics companies since March to solve energy bottlenecks](https://substack.com/redirect/3d42ca5d-d4fb-4e2a-b82b-17b70f7ea07b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in AI infrastructure by using light instead of electricity for data transfer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3d42ca5d-d4fb-4e2a-b82b-17b70f7ea07b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Photonics Replaces Copper:** Light-based transmission offers more efficiency than electrical signals on copper, addressing a major blocker to broader AI rollout.
* **Major Investments Announced:** Nvidia backed Lumentum, Coherent and Marvell with $2 Billion total plus $500 million each in Corning and Ayar Labs.
* **Capacity Shortfall Noted:** Jensen Huang stated silicon photonics technology needed is substantially higher than current world supply for next-generation AI rack solutions.
* **Stocks Surge Higher:** Lumentum shares rose 134%, Coherent 96%, Marvell 122% and Corning 111% since start of year.

* * *
* * *
# [OpenAI and Oracle break ground on $16B Michigan data center](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
OpenAI and Oracle are breaking ground for their **[sixteen billion dollar Stargate campus](https://substack.com/redirect/67bf877f-3e76-413e-a9d8-c9c50be47e24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in Saline Township, Michigan, developed by Related Digital.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67bf877f-3e76-413e-a9d8-c9c50be47e24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Project Scale Detailed:** 350,000 square foot buildings on 250 acres with nearly 700 total acres and more than half preserved as farmland.
* **Timeline and Cash Flow:** Delivery targeted for end of 2027 with immediate cash flow expected afterward and strong return profile versus high-rise builds.
* **Community Concerns Addressed:** Closed-loop cooling uses less water than farmers while contributions go to local fire department and recreation center after initial opposition and lawsuit settlement.

* * *
* * *
# [Nvidia launches Arm chip for new Windows laptops](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia unveiled its N1X Arm-based processor inside the RTX Spark superchip for a **[fresh line of Windows laptops and desktops](https://substack.com/redirect/f81f38e6-56ad-4a1b-83b5-d9ee30ed0778?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from Microsoft, Dell, HP and others debuting this fall.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f81f38e6-56ad-4a1b-83b5-d9ee30ed0778?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **PC Reinvention Called Major:** Jensen Huang described it as significant as the shift from phones to smartphones with "agentic" AI running across all new computers.
* **Superchip Combines Components:** The processor pairs Blackwell GPU with custom Arm N1X CPU designed by MediaTek plus 128GB of unified memory.
* **Broad Partner Lineup:** Models from Microsoft, Dell, HP, ASUS, Lenovo and MSI will feature the chip initially targeted at creators, AI developers and gamers.
* **Vera CPU Now Producing:** Data center Vera CPU entered full production with early adoption by OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, Dell, Oracle and CoreWeave.

# [AI Boom crushes Pre-ChatGPT "Unicorn" valuations](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nearly half of America's857 "unicorn" startups **[have gone three years without fresh funding](https://substack.com/redirect/bc1dff41-aa0b-4eaf-954c-0d38e2f633b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as the AI surge devalues pre-ChatGPT companies built in the prior boom.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bc1dff41-aa0b-4eaf-954c-0d38e2f633b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Valuation Drops Severe:** Startups that last raised in 2021 are now worth 68% less on average while 2022 raisers declined 52%.
* **Fallen Unicorns Multiply:** More than 220 billion-dollar firms are now classified as "fallen" including Glossier, Savage X Fenty, AG1 and The Farmer's Dog.
* **Capital Redirected Heavily:** Over $250 Billion has been funneled into OpenAI and Anthropic resetting market expectations for entire classes of non-AI-first companies.
* **SaaS Sector Hit Hardest:** Seventy five enterprise software firms lead the fallen unicorns as generative AI enables far fewer engineers to achieve previous output levels.

# [S&P Record echoes narrow Dotcom Bubble peak](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The S&P 500 closed at a record Friday with only twenty stocks hitting new highs, **[mirroring the narrow leadership](https://substack.com/redirect/1450c8e3-c7dc-4e8d-a191-b11c2b2bfe20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** seen at the March 2000 dot-com bubble top.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a6980265-576b-4ffe-bbc7-6aba7e44a701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Limited New Highs:** Just seven of the twenty record-setting stocks were unrelated to artificial intelligence amid semiconductor-driven gains.
* **May Rally Led By Chips:** Memory chip makers including Micron jumped 88% and AMD 46% while Nasdaq posted its best two-month stretch in over two decades.
* **Breadth Concerns Rise:** Advance-decline lines lagged after April surge and only 55% of S&P members traded above two hundred-day moving averages.
* **Defensive Roadmap Issued:** Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett noted the similarity and advised shifting to long bonds plus undervalued defensive positions in sectors that have been ignored.

# [Kalshi hires Ex-FBI analyst for surveillance](https://substack.com/redirect/d204790f-db7e-4fd2-a025-ed199a3095fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

It’s officially summer, Peter, which means millions of Texas children are on summer vacation.
For families, that should mean having fun at swimming pools, time spent in the sun, and a break from school. Instead, families across the state are facing the reality of their neighborhood schools closing not just for the summer, but for good.
Greg Abbott isn’t focused on keeping our schools open; he’s focused on pushing his voucher scheme that drains funding from public schools. Then he turns a blind eye to the dozens of public schools being closed all across the state.
Texas is an economic powerhouse. We should be leading the nation in well-funded public schools. Texas families should feel confident that their neighborhood school will still be there in the fall. Instead, Abbott is choosing to line the pockets of his billionaire buddies.
Texas families deserve a governor who treats public education as a priority. I’m running for governor because I believe our state should fund public schools so Texas kids have what they need to prosper year-round.

These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

clean_body: This might be a sign of something bigger | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. name: Rose Penelope Yee
subject: What Real Representation Can Be: People’s Policy Council
body:
When you vote for me, you're doing more than sending a fighter for your rights to Congress.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/RrBtshbVbOB?e=8c53948e4c&c2id=06d66eac9b545d55bb613c1fdc65532c)
| | | | | |
# People’s Policy Council
---
| | Hello friends,
When you vote for me, you're doing more than sending a fighter for your rights to Congress.
You're helping create a new model of representation.
For too long, elected officials have spent more time listening to lobbyists, corporate donors, and party leaders than to the people they were elected to serve. I believe it's time to change that.
As your Congresswoman, I will establish a **People's Policy Council** for California's District 2.
The Council will include representatives from every county in the district, along with representatives from constituencies that deserve a seat at the table: veterans, Indigenous communities, youth, LGBTQ residents, working families, small business owners, labor, and others. I also welcome participation from Greens, Peace and Freedom voters, independents, Republicans, Libertarians, and anyone who wants to help build a better future for our district.
Council members will serve on a rotating volunteer basis and meet with me regularly throughout the year. They will bring forward the concerns, ideas, and priorities they are hearing from their communities. In turn, I will report back on what is happening in Washington, the legislation being considered, and the challenges and opportunities facing our district. Together, we will create an ongoing conversation between the people of District 2 and their representative in Congress.
**The People's Policy Council is my commitment that no lobbyist, corporate donor, or the establishment will ever have more influence over my decisions than the people of District 2.**
This is about making real what a representative government is.
It is a form of co-governance that makes accountability real - not just every two years on Election Day, but every month. It ensures that the voices of working people remain at the center of the decisions being made in Washington.
If elected, District 2 can become a national model for democratic participation and community-led governance. We can show that elected officials don't have to answer to party insiders, corporate PACs, or powerful special interests. They can answer directly to the people.
And if this model succeeds here, it can be replicated across the country.That's how we begin building a government that truly serves **People** , **Peace** , and **Planet**.
Yours in solidarity,Rose
P.S. This vision only becomes reality if we win. If you believe Congress should answer to people instead of corporate PACs, lobbyists, and party insiders, **please donate today and vote by June 2**. Together, let's show the country what real representation looks like.

I've always been passionate about politics — you can probably gather as much if you've seen any of my social media posts :) I pride myself on my hot (_correct!_) takes. But public service has always been my driving force. I come from a long legacy of public service, from my great-great-grandparents to my mother, Caroline Kennedy.
**I have big shoes to fill.** I've known it all my life. But this is bigger than living up to my family name. This is about serving the people of New York — the city that shaped me into the person I am today.
Right now, our country is in crisis. Donald Trump and his cronies (my cousin RFK Jr., to name just one) are tanking the economy, attacking free speech, and sowing distrust in decades of scientific research.
I believe in a politics that works for the people it was intended to serve, and I'm ready to fight for it. I want to be excited and feel hopeful about our future, and I want my fellow New Yorkers to feel the same way. We need to revive empathy and effort.
**I happen to think caring is cool.**
None of this will be easy. But in the words of my grandfather, I'm doing this "not because it is easy, but because it is hard." #
# **$2 Million to Make Lincoln Drive Safer**
**** Senator Hughes was proud to join Representative Tarik Khan and the office of Councilwoman Cindy Bass to announce $2 million dollars for safety upgrades on Lincoln Drive. The funding for Lincoln Drive will be used for traffic-calming measures like speed bumps and speed slots. The goal is to make the road safer for drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians. [](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17135) State funding for this project was secured despite serious competition for limited resources. The investment is part of a broader effort from the Shapiro Administration and PennDOT to improve road safety.
* * *
[Visit our website](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17134) to learn more and follow us on [Instagram](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17136), [Facebook](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17137), [Tiktok](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17138), [Bluesky](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17139), and [X](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171834.173092.517&gen=1&mailing_linkid=17140) for the latest updates from Senator Hughes.

| | Dear Friend,

How much do you know about the Electoral College?

It's an important topic, and one vital to our nation's future.

You see, a movement is growing, led by progressives but supported by many well-meaning Americans, to change the way we elect our president.

**Their goal: to get rid of the Electoral College altogether, and "move beyond" the Constitution and Declaration. **

**That 's why I hope you'll take our National Quiz on Presidential Selection today.** It's a quick and engaging way to test your own understanding of how our presidents are elected.

**You can take your quiz by using the secure link below:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/lhjPnbgQ5UIOYhs4eNTdw1xMSiqSaNBvPAB1XiK95TpKKkFzm0Q817tqIiZznIP-LTMOzTnaZQ3hu2PKEP0BNqtEcegR5vEXTHlqAXUvE1z770mB2yG8HfG0E_kIl8G0VRbP7_WfDO5gmWUZUz2RgLu8QQVuPo2Q2Z5jumhWjt7427OX9mnxIMrBh0G6QwXHqVaLYN3wimQn_BYEzh4taCLvDQjCfzSqjMckekooXJq41jN3hxwq3rztC0YCw-E7NmkcK1yLx50ht_jGD0g1tLSJb2yqeknVLsRqWWotzYzGj6ceUQmUwvy0QEm9_dO45sqynON762pV9bmenpicUnI6DgBG1-JyPhZji5jPLOf2E7AR4NBg1zDdRKkdjzByluuEo61_B31pUzUy76oELU74FYdNgBXSoitMRQTJbivNKnWRFRdfXj1MzbQhdVR1janIzJT3QqRqMtzVzf7OJHWWkIE5a_LaCKoID5GTggzPO2uNKuByWjSWurW89H0KzicovbBb0McpKXqESkb4MUBG08y_GvU1eQNwwvuYsaZPrVqcfCBgNYArfdwz1QKBnLE6YTH_k8LgHR-TnZ4V8wle7Pw4qQlSc6L__2SxUXjvpzsBpXl9Hoc0VhDdXia5dOb8sc3R9OKEseHm--cirOIE3chH9DSQ7njFPoGBdLTA1h8h0RO-VfFeGf-Ix3eV0RDGO54r1ghwje3huUbQNOrF-qzjbAqhZJLw0A5lRd89IZ-eWK3K7-OPUEFrxns45v08c1FUKd9r33YdVW-xTjKRRqWAYrnCVBW5S6QEfl3zKSYnKSF7Cg4F6FBIsim-6g/Gzj6gZYqwpumWhDlfN5a12mhgF0jipYr/21)

For most of our history, the Electoral College was uncontroversial. It was understood to be a safeguard for free and representative government.

**But today, dozens of states have joined together to undermine this key constitutional protection.**

The push to "move beyond" the Constitution stems from the failure of too many schools to teach American civics properly. Many citizens today don't fully understand the importance of the Constitution and the Electoral College in preserving liberty.

To counter this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, **reaching and teaching millions** of Americans in all 50 states.

When you take the **National Quiz on Presidential Selection** , you'll gain a clearer understanding of how the Electoral College upholds liberty--and you'll have the opportunity to **share this** information with your fellow Americans.

So please take your **National Quiz on Presidential Selection**. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

**You can take the quiz using the secure link I 've provided below: **

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/I2udJMJgqrMVoZ3fURh8gf7gu9s27HwesgKYB8UJX003idDwudDI8eCXOK22JvWR_qXN6Zw7071lc4-4wMD8lU7-MsGDzjUAO6HUwdhKW46hFUDbbpMO4A46E1Zgw4Vrj7RVpaW12gGupPRqCbl9az8rcbyGOTyD6Oop6H25Ni-kUq1Rpqk55d5mpbXmykx8-BKNWBymoAVne2LWvEunTOyHuGWVbB0XWABu2V3vDQmBW2PEkttn1CKEhbd45ALyhKIF-4_Q8DAZeYPU5sUHMHBPbmJuPT00tYewWqfAIbH4NmEMu8bdywJujRlLkJOVYPcJXRNTDWlZ1_9uO_vPftCcee4yWxLieDatrYi0SWqsOqpA8tm6ipVBz0P0t5_p2QaRNQVryCJC0whpUu5d8D-rogVMgdouaTlpjkFqRIA05P5sfv8_5mmTDy9JYsPdu2gR-aRnsaJr4eCJqJhIac8quTf2f_5bgrmTpSW3hS7LfG5J5XtxJiTao_nLcFymcaG69m_QDsPu-QP7V6u_zvqM20QJBNixengs-O-01k6ILqlbhrrTuTKAv93d9-T1j5umPEpMo4pW-ZuJBAg2rDUzNPTJmvQbnNem2DRy7mUTStogBxgh_ExRJfB05dretwAbEv901nqUjwd8jXg32OhpWB8-wZfJ1SziIqvcXqnzruAxsSiapru6wu9prJsLoRbMHX7qvzfhn7Dqgof9wdImggTX-GuaMIMY9WgFjfB2Gi6f6doV-pWqB3bfH_kVXf8wFbG77e8ets18jYdI717N-C79e-Pf6kITuldB9A0w7meOSAUkRMURt1SDoMIjZA/kGGQjkJ69L5fq-q1z1bcGlTJaDjJ30wD/21)

**As a thank-you for taking the quiz, I 'll send you a free 12-minute video with a Hillsdale College professor that explains the history and purpose of the Electoral College. **

The video provides a concise, engaging, and insightful overview of the Electoral College and its significance. It would be a great resource to send to a friend or a family member!

One other thing.

Hillsdale refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly through student loans or grants--so that we can pursue truth and defend liberty independent of meddling bureaucrats in Washington, D.C. That's why your support matters so much.

So, after you take your quiz, please also consider giving a **tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, or even $100** to help us share this video with millions of Americans--especially young people who don't understand how the Constitution preserves liberty through the Electoral College. Your gift also funds our other nationwide educational outreach.

Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College in the effort to educate Americans about the Constitution and safeguard the principles of liberty. Good luck on the quiz and enjoy your video!

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement

Their goal: to get rid of the Electoral College altogether, and "move beyond" the Constitution and Declaration. That 's why I hope you'll take our National Quiz on Presidential Selection today. It's a quick and engaging way to test your own understanding of how our presidents are elected. You can take your quiz by using the secure link below: For most of our history, the Electoral College was uncontroversial. It was understood to be a safeguard for free and representative government. But today, dozens of states have joined together to undermine this key constitutional protection. The push to "move beyond" the Constitution stems from the failure of too many schools to teach American civics properly. Many citizens today don't fully understand the importance of the Constitution and the Electoral College in preserving liberty. To counter this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, reaching and teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. When you take the National Quiz on Presidential Selection , you'll gain a clearer understanding of how the Electoral College upholds liberty--and you'll have the opportunity to share this information with your fellow Americans. Your gift also funds our other nationwide educational outreach. Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College in the effort to educate Americans about the Constitution and safeguard the principles of liberty. Good luck on the quiz and enjoy your video! Warm regards, Bill Gray '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S. body:
It's hard to believe, but Election Day is tomorrow. And we're not taking anything for granted.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/1C7TAmdxGjB?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba)
| | | | | | Peter,
It’s hard to believe, but **Election Day is tomorrow!**
**And we’re not taking anything for granted.** Just this past weekend, our volunteers and I were out across the district, from meeting community members at EncinoFest in the Valley to knocking doors in Mar Vista and Marina Del Rey on the Westside. In total, we’ve spoken to thousands of voters face-to-face on the campaign trail.
One of my favorite moments of the campaign was canvassing on Saturday with high school student volunteers who are alumni of Camp Harmony, bringing my work full circle.
Here are 4 quick things you can do to help us get over the finish line:
(1) Share [this post](https://us.list-manage.com/12MpQqZYkg_?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba) on social media! It will help remind people of this election and show your support for our campaign.
(2) [Donate!](https://us.list-manage.com/2Mwe7EFoMfA?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba) Every dollar counts, and these last donations will allow us to connect to those last voters who haven’t gotten to the polls. With turnout low, this is more crucial than ever.
(3) Phone bank with us! You can sign up [here](https://us.list-manage.com/Ek9BVYrq3uq?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba) for phone-banking today at 5 PM, or sign up [here](https://us.list-manage.com/QcyTb_ql_KA?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba) for tomorrow at 4 PM.
(4) And, of course, **VOTE!** You can find information about nearby polling places [here](https://us.list-manage.com/hem7LWzUGsa?e=3cf484ad56&c2id=56d6f92d273ed6c9240a33982acf5cba).
Thank you again for all of your support. It’s because of you that we are able to make L.A. Unified a better place for all students.
---

June 1, 2026

Any reader who is a football fan, is familiar with this scenario. I am watching my beloved Steelers, and they have the ball with fourth and one at the goal line, meaning that if they can just gain one yard, they score six points.

I yell at the TV, "Go for it!" Magically, my opinion is wired from my TV to the earphones of the Steeler offensive coordinator who dutifully follows my advice.

But then the Steelers don't gain the yard but instead give the ball to their opponents and end up with nothing.

I then scream at the TV, "You idiots! You had the easy three points [a field goal from short distance] and you went for the touchdown instead."
This is how I viewed President Trump's bombing of Iran. This country has been fomenting terrorism and violence in the Mideast for decades. They held our citizens hostages in the 1970s and started a war with Iraq that killed over a million people. They want the destruction of Israel even though this small country occupies less than 0.5% of the land area of the previous Ottoman Empire and isn't bothering anybody. Their leadership consists of eighth century theocrats who stone adulterers and gays. They fund both Hezbollah and Hamas. They shout "Death to America."
And they want to build nuclear bombs so that they can terrorize their neighbors, Israel and the United States.

Iranians living in other countries would love to see this regime toppled so they can return.

And President Trump is trying to bring peace to the region with his Abraham accords that encourage the Arab world to recognize Israel's right to exist. And Iran is the biggest obstruction to this plan.

So when President Trump decided to bomb Iran, I yelled at the TV, "Go for it!" President Trump's goals were to destroy Iran's navy and air force, stop its nuclear program and replace the theocracy with a secular government.

Things have not worked out as planned. Yes, President Trump killed many of Iran's theocratic leaders, but they were just replaced with new theocrats. And the air force and navy have been decimated, but their nuclear program cremains intact and the enriched uranium needed to build a nuclear bomb is sequestered deep in a mountain along with the centrifuges to manufacture it. And all the bombs in the world cannot penetrate this mountain. To capture this uranium, we need for our military to invade the country. And there is little popular support for such action.
So now when I see President Trump on TV, I yell "You moron. These people have been killing each other for 5,000 years. They will be doing so for the next 5,000 years. What is it about your ego that made you think you could change this?"

"And did you and that Ivy League genius War Secretary Peter Hegseth ever hear of the Strait of Hormuz? Did you know that 20% of the world's oil transverses this site? Did it dawn on you that since Iranian territory borders the strait that they could easily mine it, stop the flow of oil tankers and cause gasoline prices to skyrocket and your popularity to plummet?"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d5a0e09e-5d2c-401c-a846-4998d187048f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The Strait of Hormuz

"Now the Democrats have a crack at winning the Senate. And if your unpopularity is transferred to the Republican nominee, the Democrats will win the presidency in 2028, abolish the filibuster, stack the Supreme Court with leftists who consider the Constitution a quaint relic, rule from the Bench and this will truly be the end of our democracy."
And now we hear on a daily basis from President Trump that Iran is cowered and is itching to make a deal. But that is not what Iran's leadership is saying. They already knew what President Trump and the fellow geniuses in his administration have just figured out.

Popular opinion does not matter in Iran. It doesn't matter if the economy collapses and people are starving. If they complain, they will be shot. But in the United States, high gasoline prices renders governing problematic since you can't govern when you are as popular as Chlamydia.
President Trump now has a problem. He can make a deal with Iran whereby they keep their nuclear program but deign to open the Strait of Hormuz. This will fool nobody and the President will look impotent.

Or he can bomb Iran some more. But for what purpose? Will the Iranians unconditionally surrender as President Trump once demanded? Unlikely.

Or he can reopen the Strait of Hormuz by putting boots on the ground on the Iranian territory bordering the area.

None of these options is appealing. But the last one is the best. At least it gives President Trump or a latter administration a chance to negotiate or durable peace from a greater position of strength.

But maybe he can make a deal in which the Iranians allow us to seize their uranium, give us the right to inspect their laboratories and agree to stop funding terrorism.

And maybe I will become a power forward for the Knicks.

And Iran is the biggest obstruction to this plan. So when President Trump decided to bomb Iran, I yelled at the TV, "Go for it!" President Trump's goals were to destroy Iran's navy and air force, stop its nuclear program and replace the theocracy with a secular government. Things have not worked out as planned. Yes, President Trump killed many of Iran's theocratic leaders, but they were just replaced with new theocrats. And the air force and navy have been decimated, but their nuclear program cremains intact and the enriched uranium needed to build a nuclear bomb is sequestered deep in a mountain along with the centrifuges to manufacture it. And all the bombs in the world cannot penetrate this mountain. To capture this uranium, we need for our military to invade the country. And there is little popular support for such action. So now when I see President Trump on TV, I yell "You moron. These people have been killing each other for 5,000 years. They will be doing so for the next 5,000 years. What is it about your ego that made you think you could change this?" "And did you and that Ivy League genius War Secretary Peter Hegseth ever hear of the Strait of Hormuz? Did you know that 20% of the world's oil transverses this site? Did it dawn on you that since Iranian territory borders the strait that they could easily mine it, stop the flow of oil tankers and cause gasoline prices to skyrocket and your popularity to plummet?" | | ---|---|--- The Strait of Hormuz "Now the Democrats have a crack at winning the Senate. And if your unpopularity is transferred to the Republican nominee, the Democrats will win the presidency in 2028, abolish the filibuster, stack the Supreme Court with leftists who consider the Constitution a quaint relic, rule from the Bench and this will truly be the end of our democracy." And now we hear on a daily basis from President Trump that Iran is cowered and is itching to make a deal. But that is not what Iran's leadership is saying. They already knew what President Trump and the fellow geniuses in his administration have just figured out. Popular opinion does not matter in Iran. It doesn't matter if the economy collapses and people are starving. If they complain, they will be shot. But in the United States, high gasoline prices renders governing problematic since you can't govern when you are as popular as Chlamydia. President Trump now has a problem. He can make a deal with Iran whereby they keep their nuclear program but deign to open the Strait of Hormuz. This will fool nobody and the President will look impotent. Or he can bomb Iran some more. But for what purpose? Will the Iranians unconditionally surrender as President Trump once demanded? Unlikely. Or he can reopen the Strait of Hormuz by putting boots on the ground on the Iranian territory bordering the area. None of these options is appealing. But the last one is the best. At least it gives President Trump or a latter administration a chance to negotiate or durable peace from a greater position of strength. But maybe he can make a deal in which the Iranians allow us to seize their uranium, give us the right to inspect their laboratories and agree to stop funding terrorism. And maybe I will become a power forward for the Knicks. body:
I’m writing to tell you WHY I’m doing it and WHAT is at stake.

[](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)Hey, Peter - it’s Vivek Ramaswamy. **
**By now you probably know that I am running for Governor of Ohio. I’m writing to tell you WHY I’m doing it and WHAT is at stake. **
**President Trump’s decisive re-election was more than a political comeback — it was a national gut-check. A repudiation of the corrupt ruling class. A mandate to finally take back control of our country.
As someone who has stood shoulder-to-shoulder with President Trump, I know what it takes to win. And I know what it takes to lead.
[That's why I'm running for Governor of Ohio – to lead the charge in the Buckeye State and make it a model for conservative excellence.](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._0rs-l_2fHSaMGCYhIkA)| | [**DONATE $5 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
---
| [**DONATE $15 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio._A)
---
| [**DONATE $25 HERE** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-4Sb4_bw)
---
| [**DONATE ANY AMOUNT** ](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-P-Tw)
---
This isn't about me - it's about the kind of country we want to leave for our kids. My wife Apoorva and I are raising our three kids in Ohio, and I want to make sure they inherit a state that is strong, proud, and free.
**
**
But to do that, we need to shake things up. We need to tell the truth, even when it's hard. We need to support President Trump and his America First agenda. We need to overhaul our failing schools, restore our national identity, and reject the victimhood mentality that's holding us back.
**
**
We need to secure our elections, prosecute voter fraud, and gut the bureaucratic red tape that's strangling our economy. And we need to do it all with courage, conviction, and a commitment to the values that made America great in the first place.
**
**
That's why I'm asking for your support. Whether you live in Ohio or not, I need your help to build a grassroots army that can take on the Democrat machine and the Deep State.

[So, I’m humbly asking you, will you make a contribution of any amount to my campaign right now?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
[DONATE ANY AMOUNT
](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-lF-CgbVSKYAVXYKGQ4Ylw)
This isn't just about winning an election - it's about sending a message. It's about showing the world that we're not afraid to stand up for what we believe in, even when it's hard. And it's about leaving a legacy that will outlast us all.
**
**
[So what do you say? Will you join me in this fight? Will you help me make Ohio the leader of America's revival?](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.)
**
**
Let's do this.
**
**
Sincerely,
Vivek Ramaswamy

Most of you know that my team and I are working incredibly hard. It's important work that we do gladly, and we know that sometimes, the seeds we are working so diligently to plant and tend won't emerge and bear fruit for many months (if not longer).
But last week, I needed a little fruit in _this_ season.
You probably saw that I shared we were far behind on last month's fundraising goal. I made the tough call to keep moving forward on key things we need to flip this seat in November even though we didn't yet have the funds:
* hiring **four** field organizers (doubling our team!),
* bringing on a part-time, local team member to help us with fundraising,
* securing a physical space for this next five month stretch,
* and getting a billboard designed.

Not small expenses for a grassroots campaign. We needed help, and I asked for it.
And you all said: we got you. **Hundreds of you chipped in, and you helped us reach last month 's fundraising goal. **_**Thank you!**_
Thank you for reminding me, every single week, that _you 're in this with us_. I am so grateful to be doing this work alongside each and every one of you.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/42348a3e-92ff-4e03-aed5-dda9506f227f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Last week at a meet and greet, a couple I'd met once before came up to say hello. She told me she's a school bus driver, and loves seeing our signs cropping up all over town. She also told me that when she has a little extra money, she sends some to me, some to Indivisible Tennessee, and a bit to one other candidate. "It's not much, but I figure that it adds up."
It does, friend. _It does._ I cannot tell you what that means to me and my team.
Here's how we keep that magical, multiplicative math going. If you're ready for what comes next and YOUR part in flipping this district, let me introduce you to my Field Director, Madison.
Madison is a former teacher who got involved in political organizing in TN-02 back in 2020, working on Renee Hoyos's campaign. She later worked on the field program that helped secure Susan Crawford's Supreme Court Justice victory in Wisconsin last year. Sound familiar? That's because that was the most expensive judicial race in our country's history: the race that Elon Musk tried to buy and couldn't.
**We may be outspent on this race by Tim Burchett and the GOP establishment, but we 're not going to be outworked.**
_**That 's where you come in.**_
Madison and Ami, our Deputy Field Director, are implementing a field program designed to reach and persuade every voter we need to get to the polls in November.
As of this week, we have 779 people who have signed up to volunteer on this campaign. That is something to celebrate! To reach the number of voters we need to talk with to flip this seat on election day, we need volunteers to do 300 volunteer shifts every single week reaching voters through canvassing, phone banking, and friend banking.
**In other words: we need your help**. And I know this community will show up, as you do every single time we put out the call. We don't need a lot - just a few hours a month, and more if you have it. A small price for flipping this seat and getting us the representation we deserve in Washington.
If you want to get more involved but you're nervous, or not sure if the time you have will _really_ make a difference, or have more questions about the campaign before you take the leap - I'm so excited to invite you to our **[Summer Field Kick-Off Party](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/91012df5-94fe-4e5b-9d89-4d4b02231777?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**!
**Come out this Sunday, June 7th from 11 - 2 at Printshop Beer Co in South Knoxville** to get trained on all the basics of voter outreach, learn how to talk to folks you already know about the movement we're building, and get excited and energized for this next phase of putting Hope to Work in East Tennessee.
**[Let us know you're coming here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/91012df5-94fe-4e5b-9d89-4d4b02231777?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).** And as a little extra incentive, the first 25 people get their choice of a yard sign or bumper sticker!
And if you are coming, please bring an item [off of Knox Pride's needs list](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ff64bdcc-8549-4f86-84af-6c04560a09b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which include shelf stable essentials: canned goods, crackers, protein bars, and ramen. If you're not able to make it this Sunday, you can still support by purchasing directly off their [wish list](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e86e93e2-36b2-4b94-9528-6c398d72f01c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or dropping off donations at the Pride Center (4028 Chapman Hwy, open M-F, 11am - 4pm).
One final note: we're launching a summer internship program that will run from June 16 - August 13! We're focused on developing the next generation of democratic infrastructure in our community, so if you or someone you know is looking for hands-on campaign experience and a meaningful summer, **[check it out and apply here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0a1e4507-d83a-40b4-a502-b40db740b979?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
See you soon, friends!
In gratitude and solidarity,
Michaela Barnett

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132517232/624775457/-349382464?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzhhNDI2ZC1mMjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t7tfDb84Ir6xvlfot8vwmcW-t8mpktrOULvRnX9a2RE=)
Peter,

Before anything else, I want to thank you for your continued support these last few weeks. Whether you chipped in a few dollars, knocked on doors, or simply told a neighbor about this race – it truly makes a difference.

**Election Day is tomorrow, and we're using every minute to talk directly to voters about what matters to them and making sure their voices are heard in this election.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132517233/624775458/-349382464?refcode=em-6.1.26-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzhhNDI2ZC1mMjVkLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=t7tfDb84Ir6xvlfot8vwmcW-t8mpktrOULvRnX9a2RE=)

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Hope matters when it’s hard
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3352%2E21716%2EORNUv7)
Hi, it's Sarah.
When I was growing up, I couldn’t imagine a future like mine. I worried that the heart of this country wasn’t big enough to love someone like me.
But over the years, I’ve witnessed change that once felt unimaginable. And because of voters in my home state of Delaware and supporters across the country, **I became the first openly transgender member elected to Congress.**
I’m carrying that proof of progress this Pride Month – because hope matters most when it’s hard.
Right now, it’s a frightening time for so many in our country. LGBTQ+ people, especially trans youth, are being targeted with cruelty. I know how easy it is to feel scared and discouraged. I’ve felt it too.
But we must remember that Pride was born at Stonewall in resistance, in protest, and in the belief that even in the face of fear, change is still possible. And I’m confident we can turn this moment for our community and country into a slingshot moment, where the pressure and tension of being pulled backward ultimately propels us into destinations we have not yet been.
That’s why we must continue to fight for what’s right. To celebrate ourselves and the LGBTQ+ community. And just as importantly, to keep believing that through the power of our proximity, we can bring more people along.
But we won’t get there alone.
**Pride is about the unfinished work of justice. And it’s going to take all of us to build a movement strong enough to meet this moment and carry us forward.[So if you’re ready to do your part, please pitch in today.](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260601-1.ygh1yQ&refcode=em20260601-3352&t=2&akid=3352%2E21716%2EORNUv7)**

name: AOC
subject: The struggle of our time today is the single most unjust concentration of wealth in the hands of the very few.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
It has always been in our nation’s darkest chapters that our brightest lights emerge.
And we — each and every one of us, whether we like it or not — are living history today.
From our nation’s beginning, American democracy has always reflected the struggle between humanity’s highest and lowest natures: between subjects and citizens, the Confederacy and the Union, freedom and bondage, labor and capital rights and regimes.
**It is no different today**.
The struggle of our time today is the single most unjust concentration of wealth in the hands of the very few, unseen in our nation’s and the world’s history.
**It is a time in which demanding what should be considered the most basic tenets of human dignity is considered a radical and outlandish act**.
It is a time such as today, when demanding affordable housing and decent wages is considered a radical and outlandish act.
That we could afford our lives, our groceries, our transit? Is considered a radical and outlandish act.
That we accept our neighbor as ourselves? A radical and outlandish act.
We must remember in times such as this: **we are not the crazy ones**. We are not the outlandish ones.
They want us to think we are crazy — we are sane.
To demand affordable housing, a decent wage, the right to healthcare, that we pay to care for our people instead of the flattening of Palestinians and oppressed people abroad is not a radical act — _it is basic and core humanity_.
We will send a loud message to President Donald Trump: **his authoritarianism is no good here**.
We will send a message to ICE: that **secret police do not belong here**.
When I think about what is happening throughout our nation today, and what Donald Trump has done in his demolition of the White House — we must let him know:
That house doesn’t belong to him. It belongs to us. **It belongs to the people of this country**.
There has been a day before this presidency, and there will be a day after.
**And it belongs to us**.

Thank you for being a part of this movement.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

It is the ultimate rule for trusting your own eyes and ears when the Radical Left tries to convince you to ignore the obvious truth.
Enter the presumed Democratic nominee in Maine, Graham Platner.

Peter,

**Tonight is our FINAL fundraising deadline before our primary tomorrow.**

I’ll be frank, we’re still not where we should be, and we’re down to the wire.

Every deadline from now until Election Day matters. If our campaign is going to make it to November, we cannot let up for a second.

Wealthy coastal Democrats are already pouring millions into Montana to try to buy this seat. Chuck Schumer is laser-focused on our campaign because he knows the fate of the Senate comes down to races like ours. [His dark money machine is locked and loaded, sparing no expense in Montana. ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=1eeb91f8602c4ad299631e24f391109a&_e=bUcoALay7EHnnAmPzAGGjWEQUMGyNH3SeikCVTbKcen8vCh5c71W4OpTfTQuP5JbjDLqVA3Ft9hbPZPBhmC3ELECa_px7MZqje1crbKPZJ4YxTmU5OEz_Md9ET-r5EgYB9VoTJaCSOO0G4gmOaN6deAWNkDI9oVUKsCwj8xVj_lTI245NdalG_LP5L_QT794Bn1Gzg-eifX1a9gLI26ULk5hoftFL6YvJwTPwld0Ig3Je1GMp4lS0LFOgyTGeTVMA6SGBiD-J4-Lq2KSVMA8_n-3QkE2n9_Vkm7XgBzYkh69sl2hJcYUnvv4wa-ksdZdfuR_VnRN60Htklw9QS6_718Iqzmdc7ciXltZdZLsg-c81nL7LcH5nG1GRTkaaNd7ufjSzMKFqjlpYI6B7mNV0mTE6icI6lE7g5yZyePB3d7NxlFwalbWaS_mZBhnj2cAcN3TE7Wr132JE4Y2cjVJjMz1c09DQGJQMj43OVsT_pC61vvH83HFC0rsJze3MAyte7M5O9CswX3GfdtPdU7gr7hFBqCzGhver9xoiRtSHU6Uj0hnpqX6tY9vqXzTTX2KnAZugb7rAodzyEYXDC_5nem3hi166XJXTwfrGwvWjO_C73xADtYlF1BjK4ASSJ8FmlIzw7SKqjz0oSd-lmBtSqFjaOR3gVjKekSgqZoSS16o7gr8mqYzyVSbmfeQHktofYyZd-u1EeIf4LF6_BoevF0bkq2iF2_582DP9GIb7II%3D)

I’m proud that our campaign is not relying on out-of-state left-wing millionaires from California or New York to win this race. It’s powered by folks like you who love our state and want to keep it great.

The only way our campaign survives is if we reach every goal from here on out – so we can defeat the Democrat machine.

clean_body: It’s us vs. the Democrat fundraising machine — and tonight’s deadline matters. | Peter, Tonight is our FINAL fundraising deadline before our primary tomorrow. I’ll be frank, we’re still not where we should be, and we’re down to the wire. Every deadline from now until Election Day matters. If our campaign is going to make it to November, we cannot let up for a second. Wealthy coastal Democrats are already pouring millions into Montana to try to buy this seat. Chuck Schumer is laser-focused on our campaign because he knows the fate of the Senate comes down to races like ours. I’m proud that our campaign is not relying on out-of-state left-wing millionaires from California or New York to win this race. It’s powered by folks like you who love our state and want to keep it great. The only way our campaign survives is if we reach every goal from here on out – so we can defeat the Democrat machine. Moments like this are what matter most. Right now, where we need to be before tonight’s deadline. Will you help us out? I need you with me in this race. -Kurt Alme FOLLOW KURT ALME ON SOCIAL MEDIA | | Paid for by Alme for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go: .

body:
Let’s be honest about this.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260601-1&t=1&akid=3549%2E587540%2EfC4k3J)
Peter,
Conservatives were completely prepared for their 2024 victory.
Remember **Project 2025**? It was a detailed, step-by-step blueprint for enacting a conservative policy agenda after Donald Trump won back the White House.
And according to Project 2025 Tracker, _they’ve already implemented 53% of it._
Let’s be honest about this: If progressives are serious about reclaiming power, we need our own version of this. Call it Project 2027, Project 2029... it doesn’t matter. What matters is that our version — _unlike Project 2025_ — will actually help people.
**[What do you want to see on Democrats’ policy agenda after we defeat the Republicans in 2026 and 2028? Take our quick survey to share your thoughts.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/survey/em-20260601-project-2027/?source=em20260601-3549&t=2&akid=3549%2E587540%2EfC4k3J)**

Universal healthcare. Gun safety reform. Action on climate change. Abortion rights. Housing prices. Immigration reform — and an end to ICE as we know it.
We are doing more than building a progressive wishlist here, Peter. Democrats can take back Congress and the White House in the next two elections. And we need to be prepared for what we’re going to do to help people once we do. We need to play offense, instead of the weak defense we’ve been showcasing.
When we get the results back in the next week or two we will send you an update with the top suggestions we received.

David Hogg

Hi Friend, Since Inauguration Day, Donald Trump has spent every hour of every day trying to destroy everything that is good about the USA. Naturally, we are all furious **and** exhausted. But on November 3, we can do something about it. We can vote in big enough numbers to **crush Trump and all of his MAGA Republican allies** everywhere. We **all** need to vote - and also mobilize every Democrat, Independent, and sane Republican we know. It’s that simple.
### **Trump is Drowning**
Just look at [Trump’s approval rating](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.RNKlYhK-gnABEpCnH88uwEOAOe_ie7_go-krXhMKHOb0pEI4gmej75BdaTgO07e9pNOhAZNU_PBW9J9QALdnFrEsoue5SboYaa60zOSxFNC9n0NSl7q6D68ehBirx4Jjm6ReGpx8_6_IpiQSG9n7-VPyqOMrznBE3YmeTnsTg4SA_cCp1CHFRPBaI2SnXBuSkO2YNwFNYU7_sOA_54a1mel-5bpU7fA8DYxKhl2O3o8yyTEqzzUbZFx9uuD12NmryBlAl-hNt4o2LbNfY3WGNJKJUOL-2myPqVqbtrcZ5be9o7CRY2wCJERGqpG4gdGl/4r4/QwmUqCAjRpuKzqzQB7lI2g/h1/h001.WhOltwwspotQlIvzyUeoLNPRWCiv-albbv1d4mkbK-4): only 36% of Americans approve of his Presidency, while 60% disapprove. That’s an astonishing **minus 23%** \- way below any other President in this century, including Trump’s first term. And Trump’s approval keeps going down. Every day that Americans pay over $4 per gallon for gas, Trump’s approval sinks even lower. Even if Iran agrees to a deal soon, gas and diesel prices will remain high for months – driving up the cost of groceries and everything else we buy. Millions of Republican voters are furious about Trump’s betrayal on higher prices **and** disastrous wars. And Trump’s sabotage of sane Senate Republicans like Thom Tillis, John Cassidy and John Cornyn is pushing them to finally stand up to Trump’s corruption - especially his $1 billion ballroom and $1.7 billion “weaponization” fund for convicted J6 cop beaters. Even judges are turning against Trump on issues from tariffs to immigration to the Kennedy Center. And as Trump gets weaker at home and abroad, his rage gets more out of control.
