| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEJune 1, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**NEW INDEPENDENT POLL SHOWS LETLOW LEADING RUNOFF WITH 15-POINT LEAD** _New Poll Shows Letlow Leading Fleming 52%-37%, Dominating Key Republican Voting Blocs_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — A new [survey](https://us.list-manage.com/_ZnFKMMnkJn?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a) of Louisiana Republican voters shows Congresswoman Julia Letlow holding a commanding 15-point lead over John Fleming in the Republican runoff election for U.S. Senate, 52% to 37%.
The poll underscores the continued consolidation of Republican support behind Letlow's campaign as voters rally around the Trump-endorsed conservative in the race. Letlow leads Fleming 57%-31% among self-identified Very Conservative voters, 50%-32% among women, and holds a lead of more than 40 points among voters under the age of 50.
---
|
---
| | | | | | The survey is the latest sign of growing momentum behind Letlow's campaign following her first-place finish in the Republican primary, President Donald J. Trump's complete and total endorsement, and a wave of support from conservative leaders across Louisiana and across the country.
_"Louisiana Republicans are rallying behind Julia Letlow because they know she is the conservative candidate President Trump trusts to fight for Louisiana and advance the America First agenda,”_ **said Katherine Thordahl, Communications Director for Letlow for Louisiana.**_“This poll shows Julia building a broad coalition across the Republican Party and continuing to gain momentum as we head toward Election Day."_
Letlow advanced to the runoff after finishing first in the Republican primary and carrying 52 of Louisiana's 64 parishes. Since then, her campaign has continued to build support among grassroots conservatives, elected officials, law enforcement leaders, farmers, energy workers, and Republican voters across the state.
The Republican runoff election will be held on June 27.
###

| Friend, last fall, Ken Paxton launched a baseless investigation into Powered by People and threatened to jail me.

But his lawsuit was never really about the law. It was about trying to scare us out of organizing, out of speaking up, out of doing the work it takes to build power in Texas.

We’re now back in court making sure that we present the facts and restore freedom of speech in Texas. Paxton, on the other hand, is getting called out by judges for what they’ve described as “unprofessional conduct.” I’m grateful for the progress we’ve made, but must also acknowledge the real cost to standing up to his abuse of power.

**We’ve now spent more than $500,000 in legal fees fighting Paxton’s frivolous lawsuits.**

Every dollar we’re forced to spend fighting him in court is a dollar we can’t put into the work that actually gets people registered and turned out to vote.

That’s the point of Paxton's attacks. To drain us, slow us down, and make the relational organizing work we do that much harder.

We recently exhausted the initial retainer we set aside to defend ourselves. If we’re going to beat him in court and keep organizing across Texas, we need your help.

I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground.

Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible.

_Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona_
---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens.

And it's not isolated growth anymore.

**We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. **

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

What's different now is the pace.

**Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: **

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida
✅ Idaho
✅ Indiana
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Oklahoma
✅ South Carolina
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action.

That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly.

It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up.

Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through.

And right now, that's where we're stretched.

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

_So here 's how you can help... _

Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it.

**An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: **

✅ Constitutions.
✅ Chapter guides.
✅ Flags.
✅ Materials to organize and lead.

It turns a student who wants to speak up... _into one who actually does. _

And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here."

**P.S.** Patriot, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture.

But moments like this don't sustain themselves.

If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple.

**We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. **

clean_body: I think this is where things are heading | | | | | Patriot, I want to give you a picture of what's really happening right now -- not the polished version, but what it actually looks like on the ground. Inside our office, tables are covered in supplies and open boxes. Coworkers are coming together, packing materials, sealing kits, and sending them out the door as fast as possible. Above: Activism kits bound for new chapters being packed with Constitutions, chapter handbooks, American flags, and more at TPUSA HQ in Arizona These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them. They're already claimed. And we don't have extras. By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in. Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it. That's where things stand right now. We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment. And I don't say that lightly. Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down. The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great. And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing. Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back. We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there. And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet. That's not something you can just manufacture. But it is something you can support when it happens. And it's not isolated growth anymore. We 're now working with more than 1,450 college chapters and over 3,400 high school chapters across the country. That's real scale. But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America. That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation... And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak. So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build. What's different now is the pace. Many states are moving to bring Club America chapters to every high school statewide, including: ✅ Arkansas ✅ Florida ✅ Idaho ✅ Indiana ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Oklahoma ✅ South Carolina ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee That brings us to ten states now taking this seriously -- not just talk, but action. That kind of expansion doesn't happen slowly. It stacks quickly -- and it creates pressure behind the scenes to keep up. Because every new chapter, every new student leader, every new school means more materials, more support, more follow-through. And right now, that's where we're stretched. We're not lacking interest or momentum. We're working to keep up with both. So here 's how you can help... Right now, there are students ready to step up -- they just need the tools to do it. An activism kit puts everything they need directly into their hands: ✅ Constitutions. ✅ Chapter guides. ✅ Flags. ✅ Materials to organize and lead. It turns a student who wants to speak up... into one who actually does. And you'll make it possible for us to keep saying yes when a student reaches out and says, "I want to start something here." Every activism kit you help sponsor means one more student is ready to lead instead of sitting on the sidelines. That's how we keep saying "yes" when the next student steps forward. That's how this movement actually scales. Because the reality is, the demand is here now. The only question is whether we're equipped to meet it. And that comes down to whether people like you decide to step in and help carry this forward. One final thing: I also wanted to say thank you. If you've supported Turning Point USA before -- whether once or many times -- you've already played a role in building what you're seeing right now. Students finding their voice. More state partnerships. New TPUSA chapters like the one at Charlie's former high school. This kind of momentum doesn't happen without people willing to stand behind it. And we don't take that lightly. I appreciate you taking the time to read this, and for everything you've already done to support this work. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. Patriot, what you're seeing right now is something we've been working toward for years -- a generation of young Americans who are no longer willing to sit quietly while the Left dominates their schools and culture. But moments like this don't sustain themselves. If we don't keep up, we lose ground. It's that simple. We need to keep pace with the growth happening right now -- to fund more activism kits, support more chapters, and make sure no student is left standing alone after they decide to speak up. If you've already supported Turning Point USA in the past, thank you for carrying this movement forward every single day. If you haven't yet, I'm asking you to step in now. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

Semper Fi, Joe Males Meet Joe Males: Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life’s mission. Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved. Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he’s determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same. Joe’s entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy. During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met. Maxine

It is when senators leave Washington and start talking. It is when federal employees clock out at 4 p.m. and answer their phones at bars. It is when defense contractors take meetings in steakhouses, when teachers get loose at conferences, when state election officials get sloppy. The legacy media is at the beach. The agencies run on skeleton crews. The targets we have been working on for months — quietly, patiently — finally drop their guard. Summer is also when the donations stop. [**We need your support**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkT2PnDAQhn-N6Vj5Y_HhwkUkRHdpU6LBHoNz2Eb-CH8_YqOtUl057zzzSo_m1-fyCf7wcfsJAXWubsllKS0EzL5cO8YL9xbr7xbRl2vhlMueyp6ym2Od1dZYYKZDzT5GKp5q4KrbtcXBGWfc4Ny6DtZwAfTprHFsHAeqVOf1XUUlZZwJToeHVU7iqihVVIEcHXlSODDXR8azrYc3ECuUL5eywYdJoTv0XutZiPhB-Ez4XNC0jA-IaFO9CcLn9IXoMKD1sOXUzjsKW3_b9Mj6ANXsfVj7M51AxNxqWEpq2SAR038g4fIG7rYWiJheR_8yA-EEv0UiprfWe5NixViJmHJ1hEsIqb1GMXRZ2_Pyx-GL_CBPugXwx0utfv8RfzT_GwAA__-67ppf). Americans have other things to spend money on in June, July, and August. Vacations. Camps. Property taxes. I understand. But for this organization, the calendar is the opposite of the bank account — the most productive months of the year are also the months we have to scrape to stay in the field. A longtime donor of OMG knows this too. And this morning, he did something about it. **He put $48,000 on the table — and told me he will match every dollar OMG raises between June 1 and June 15, up to that full amount.[**Will you chip in?**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkT2PnDAQhn-N6Vj5Y_HhwkUkRHdpU6LBHoNz2Eb-CH8_YqOtUl057zzzSo_m1-fyCf7wcfsJAXWubsllKS0EzL5cO8YL9xbr7xbRl2vhlMueyp6ym2Od1dZYYKZDzT5GKp5q4KrbtcXBGWfc4Ny6DtZwAfTprHFsHAeqVOf1XUUlZZwJToeHVU7iqihVVIEcHXlSODDXR8azrYc3ECuUL5eywYdJoTv0XutZiPhB-Ez4XNC0jA-IaFO9CcLn9IXoMKD1sOXUzjsKW3_b9Mj6ANXsfVj7M51AxNxqWEpq2SAR038g4fIG7rYWiJheR_8yA-EEv0UiprfWe5NixViJmHJ1hEsIqb1GMXRZ2_Pyx-GL_CBPugXwx0utfv8RfzT_GwAA__-67ppf)** If we hit $48,000 in the first half of June, he doubles it. That is $96,000 — every operational expense for the month of June, covered in full, with the entire summer freed up to do what we do best. If we miss it, the match disappears. [**Every donation still helps**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkT2PnDAQhn-N6Vj5Y_HhwkUkRHdpU6LBHoNz2Eb-CH8_YqOtUl057zzzSo_m1-fyCf7wcfsJAXWubsllKS0EzL5cO8YL9xbr7xbRl2vhlMueyp6ym2Od1dZYYKZDzT5GKp5q4KrbtcXBGWfc4Ny6DtZwAfTprHFsHAeqVOf1XUUlZZwJToeHVU7iqihVVIEcHXlSODDXR8azrYc3ECuUL5eywYdJoTv0XutZiPhB-Ez4XNC0jA-IaFO9CcLn9IXoMKD1sOXUzjsKW3_b9Mj6ANXsfVj7M51AxNxqWEpq2SAR038g4fIG7rYWiJheR_8yA-EEv0UiprfWe5NixViJmHJ1hEsIqb1GMXRZ2_Pyx-GL_CBPugXwx0utfv8RfzT_GwAA__-67ppf). But the doubling is gone. [**▶ DOUBLE YOUR GIFT — MATCH ENDS JUNE 15**](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkT2PnDAQhn-N6Vj5Y_HhwkUkRHdpU6LBHoNz2Eb-CH8_YqOtUl057zzzSo_m1-fyCf7wcfsJAXWubsllKS0EzL5cO8YL9xbr7xbRl2vhlMueyp6ym2Od1dZYYKZDzT5GKp5q4KrbtcXBGWfc4Ny6DtZwAfTprHFsHAeqVOf1XUUlZZwJToeHVU7iqihVVIEcHXlSODDXR8azrYc3ECuUL5eywYdJoTv0XutZiPhB-Ez4XNC0jA-IaFO9CcLn9IXoMKD1sOXUzjsKW3_b9Mj6ANXsfVj7M51AxNxqWEpq2SAR038g4fIG7rYWiJheR_8yA-EEv0UiprfWe5NixViJmHJ1hEsIqb1GMXRZ2_Pyx-GL_CBPugXwx0utfv8RfzT_GwAA__-67ppf) Here is what your matched dollar pays for between now and Labor Day: Investigations we have been building for months that are nearly ready to release. Field journalists wired up and walking into rooms with people they have spent the spring earning trust from. Legal review on three pieces of footage right now that involve named federal employees. Editors working late to splice testimony admissions against the public denials those same people made on the record. This is not theoretical. This is the calendar I am looking at on my desk right now. body:
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4629?t=1&akid=2329%2E5691347%2EQi2o3n)

Yesterday, I rallied a crowd in Atlanta to oppose this Administration’s unprecedented attack on our Constitution and the rule of law.
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jun26.cWQ5pb&refcode=em260601-1-subs&t=2&akid=2329%2E5691347%2EQi2o3n)
[**(You can watch my speech here on YouTube.)**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5022?t=3&akid=2329%2E5691347%2EQi2o3n)
Here's what I said:
Atlanta, these crowds, they keep growing. Something is happening in Georgia. Every backyard, every living room is full, and crowds like this leave no doubt that Georgia is ready to do our part again to save our Republic.
Something is finally waking up. Do you feel it?
Now, many of you are here because you recognize the urgency of opposition to this unprecedented corruption and incompetence, and you recognize the stakes of these midterm elections when Georgia's voice will be decisive once again.
His presidency crumbling, Donald spent Saturday complaining on the internet. Listen to this. Six hours, 52 posts.
The President attacked the Pope. He posted his own face on Mount Rushmore and a made-up Trump Peace Prize. He announced three times “America's back” and he assured an increasingly concerned public he’s in excellent health.
And when not posting, he's been trying to rob us.
Have you seen it? He sued the U.S. government he commands for $10 billion. Then, he settled the suit with himself to create a $1.8 billion slush fund, so he can cut checks to cronies and Jan. 6 footsoldiers.
The same men who sacked the Capitol to seize the presidency for Donald Trump, who beat police officers with flag poles, built a gallows on the Capitol lawn, and hunted the Vice President to lynch him. Donald Trump's brownshirts. He pardoned them, and now he wants you to pay them.
He's trying to put his face on the money. _Did you see that?_
He's building a monument to himself. But see, Atlanta, he's doing these things now, because no one will honor him when he's gone. Because he's a failed president and a national disgrace.
He promised to bring down prices on day one. Instead, prices are soaring.
Ground beef’s up 25% since Trump was sworn in, coffee 40%, the price of gas 33%. Groceries, rent, health care, and the power bill hit their new all-time highs last month. And while you pay more for everything, Donald Trump wants your tax dollars for what many are calling the Jeffrey Epstein Memorial Ballroom.
By the way, he forced out that Republican congressman, the one who made him release the Epstein files. Did you see that? That is true commitment to the cover-up.
This President promised a Golden Age. Instead, the economy has lost tens of thousands of manufacturing jobs since he launched the big illegal tariffs, and more Americans are falling behind on their credit cards than any time since the Great Recession. Inflation’s higher than when Trump took office, unemployment’s higher than when Trump took office, and consumer sentiment is at its worst in 70 years.
The President promised to fight for the working class and end foreign wars. Instead, he cut your health care to give the rich another tax break. And last week, yet more Americans were wounded in a war no one voted for, and no one can explain.
This war in Iran is the worst foreign policy blunder since Iraq, and just like the Iraq war, it's a war built on lies.
Let's just update the record.
On day one of the war, day one, the President said it was running ahead of schedule.
On day 10, he said it was “very complete.”
Day 21, “getting very close.”
Day 32, “leaving very soon.”
On day 39, the President of the United States said “a whole civilization will die tonight.” And on the next day, day 40, he declared “total and complete victory.”
Day 67, “great progress.”
Day 79, the “clock is ticking.”
Today is day 92, and on day 92, Iran's ballistic missiles and drones have not been destroyed.
The Strait of Hormuz, which was open before the war, is still closed. The regime is intact, along with its stockpile of highly enriched uranium, a stockpile Iran only built after President Trump shredded President Obama's Iran deal. You remember that?
Just weeks into this war, they said they'd need $200 billion to fund it. Let me put that in perspective for you. $200 billion would fund a decade — 10 full years — of nationwide universal pre-kindergarten.
The America First President, who said he would end foreign wars to put America first and focus on America's working class, instead, now he says it's not possible for us to take care of daycare, Medicaid, or Medicare. Now he says all we can afford is war.
Now he demands we cut cancer and Alzheimer's research to throw even more money at Pete Hegseth’s Pentagon. While the Financial Times reports, “Pete Hegseth broker looked to buy defense fund before Iran attack.”
Y'all remember they promised to drain the swamp?
Instead, this is the most corrupt administration of all time, and everybody knows it. Everybody knows it.
While Americans pay more and get less, while our insurance premiums skyrocket, and hospitals close down services, while American service members are wounded and killed in action... the First Family’s raking in billions of dollars.
Just listen to this, last September, the President of Kazakhstan calls Donald Trump and says he wants to grant tungsten mining rights to an American company.
And the very next month, Eric and Don Jr. get a stake in the American company pursuing the mining deal.
Six days later, six days after Prince Eric and Prince Don get their stake, Kazakhstan announces this company will get “the largest known undeveloped tungsten resource in the world.”
A few more weeks go by, and then the U.S. government, run by their father, sets aside $1.6 billion of your tax dollars to fund and finance their mining project. _In Kazakhstan._
All this while you pay more for gas, for groceries, for health care, and that's just the tip of the iceberg.
Billions from foreign princes and oligarchs, sweetheart real estate deals all over the world, taxpayer funding to Trump-backed companies. And listen, here's the bottom line: If you're involved in any of this, next year, you'll be raising your right hand and swearing to tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God, in front of the United States Congress.
The Mar-a-Lago mafia has taken American corruption to spectacular new heights, but corruption in America runs a lot deeper than Donald Trump. American politics is coin-operated. Money goes in, favors come out, and that's why spectacular wealth buys an ever-greater share of power over our national affairs, while the mere citizen is treated with contempt.
_Citizens United_ was the most destructive court decision in modern American history. It's unleashed a flood of secret money, corporate money, billionaire money on both sides.
Members of Congress live in fear of these Super PACs, and that corruption is why insurance companies get away with denying your claim for a procedure you needed to save your life. It's why Big Tech is still allowed to spy on us and sell our lives to the highest bidder. It's why the ultra rich get another tax break while you pay more for everything.
Donald Trump's rise is a symptom of this deeper disease, and I suspect many of you are here because you recognize that our task is not just to contain his wickedness, but to cure the rot that gave rise to it.
That this broken moment is an opening, not for restoration, but for reformation. Because who really supports allowing unlimited secret political money to bend the national agenda in darkness?
In East Point or Valdosta or Brunswick or Columbus — if I ask anyone, Democrat, independent, Republican, none of the above — if I ask them whether this is how things should work, doesn't matter who they are, the answer is a resounding no. And if it takes a constitutional amendment to end Citizens United, we'll deliver a United Georgia to ratify it.
Now speaking of corruption, my two opponents. See, they tried to run Kemp, but he refused. So we're left with the congressman who's only a congressman because his daddy was a congressman and the coach who's only a coach because his daddy was a coach.
And both already mired in scandal. The congressman under investigation for paying your tax dollars to his criminal staffer's girlfriend for apparently no work, while the coach's family got tens of millions of your tax dollars, courtesy of Governor Kemp, and then poured cash into the governor's PAC to prop up the coach’s campaign.
They should have to come out and answer questions about all of it, right now.
But Atlanta, it doesn't matter which one wins. They're both corrupt political insiders, and they're both pro-war, pro-tariff, and pro-cutting your health care. They're both Trump puppets, and we'll beat either one of them in November.
And Atlanta, we will win with a coalition that extends far beyond party lines, because this campaign is not just for Democrats, it's for everyone who sees things spiraling out of our control, who longs for sanity and competence and sees the same old politics failing.
Everywhere across our state, people tell me they're desperate for change and desperate for new ideas.
The young couple expecting their first child, who wonder how they'll afford a crib and a stroller, let alone a first home, and their health insurance just went up a thousand bucks a month.
The student working through college, who still needs food stamps to make rent, whose conscience can't stand their tax dollars being used to lock up immigrant children at home or to kill innocent children abroad.
The South Georgia farmer, whose costs rise and earnings fall each year, whose kids have left the family farm, who had to wait almost two years for federal aid after the hurricane.
See, Georgians are sick of being ripped off, taken for granted, disrespected. Because we're told a story that if we work hard and play by the rules, we'll thrive. That no matter who we are or where we start, the grind will pay off.
But for too many across our state, this story just isn't true. Groceries, rent, insurance, taxes, the car note, the power bill — the math just does not work. And it feels like, no matter how hard you hustle, you can't get ahead.
The culture wars are exploited to divide us, while our hospitals close, while hedge funds buy up all the houses in our neighborhood, while we have to pay $3,000 for an ambulance.
And Georgia is in the midst of a health care emergency. It's an emergency that some of our so-called leaders dress up as normal. They try to numb us to the suffering they've caused.
They've continued to block Medicaid expansion, while Georgia lost 21 hospitals in 20 years.
And then last year, they gutted Medicaid nationally. Listen to this: 40% of all Georgia kids are covered by Medicaid. 50% of all Georgia births are covered by Medicaid. 70% of all Georgia seniors in nursing homes are covered by Medicaid.
Already, one labor and delivery unit in Georgia has closed, citing those Medicaid cuts, with more pain coming for hospitals and clinics and nursing homes.
And then the Affordable Care Act cuts, which have doubled premiums for more than a million Georgians and caused hundreds of thousands to lose their coverage just in the last few months.
All this when here in Georgia we already have the second highest uninsured rate in the nation, the third fewest mental health providers, the fourth worst newborn weight at birth.
Just wrap your heads around this: when you're born in the state of Georgia, your life expectancy is shorter than if you were born today in Lebanon, a country that's been in a state of intermittent war for decades.
And now consider this: Our state's economy, just our state's economy, is 40 times larger than Lebanon's national economy, but they're living longer than us.
The legendary civil rights leader Marian Wright Edelman said, “We don't have a money problem. We have a profound values and priorities problem.”
Because see, this isn't just the way it is, or the way it has to be. All this needless death and suffering and misery is a choice.
Georgia's leaders have chosen to leave Georgians without insurance and without hospitals. They're down having a steak at The Palm, handing out your tax dollars to their donors, while women hemorrhage in Georgia labor wards because they didn't get prenatal care.
But Atlanta, when you elect a Medicaid-expanding Governor Bottoms in November, together we can get Georgians covered with great health care, save our hospitals, and build and open new ones to serve every county in this state.
There is an awful lot at stake.
If ever a moment called for checks and balances, this is it. And it's not just the corruption and incompetence, it's this unmistakable project, not to lead us, but to rule us as subjects.
The President, who once tried to overturn his own defeat, now tries to jail elected leaders of the opposition, tries to prosecute Americans who defy or criticize him, tries to seize control of elections nationwide.
Freedom is rare. Stretching back beyond the horizon of recorded history, most humans who have ever lived have lived at the mercy of lords and masters and kings. But we're a nation founded on the rejection of kingdom. We're a nation founded on the radical idea that all human beings have a natural right to liberty.
Dr. King said of our Declaration, "Never before in the history of the world has a sociopolitical document expressed in such profound, eloquent, and unequivocal language the dignity and worth of human personality.”
And from those founding ideals, despite our sins and through courageous struggle, the flame of American freedom has grown brighter and bolder and given hope to the whole world. But in the winds that blow today, that light is flickering.
And of all the freedoms hanging in the balance, none is more precious than the right to vote. We see the Voting Rights Act eviscerated, and then, like clockwork, as if they'd been lying in wait 61 years, since the moment the ink dried from President Johnson's pen, the President's allies set out to remove Black elected officials, not by defeating them at the polls, but by manipulating maps to dilute minority power.
_Do you all see it?_
The Fulton County raid, the executive order attacking voting, the MAGA loyalists on our state election board, they’ve made their plans very clear.
But Georgia Democrats are prepared to answer with a mobilization so massive and a defense of voting rights so fierce that no plot against the franchise will foil the will of the people.
Because Atlanta, how foolish of them to come to the cradle of the Civil Rights Movement to spread those lies and seize those ballots? How foolish to launch an attack on voting rights here at the political and spiritual center of the very Black history they seek to erase.
Their attacks only strengthen our resolve, and if all of us here do what we must do, the sound of feet marching to the polls this fall will be heard in every corner of our state and all the way up on high, where Congressman Lewis will look down and see a job well done.
We stand here, together, in Congressman Lewis's district, and I promise you his spirit is with us in this place right now. In his final years, resisting the tide of deepening cynicism, he still elevated us. He reminded us that we all live in one American house and one world house. He called it the inevitable truth that we are all members of one human family.
And I suspect many of you are here today because you're deeply troubled by the pain so many of our fellow Georgians and fellow Americans and fellow human beings are enduring right now. The terror of a child watching ICE take away his mother. The despair of a cancer patient losing coverage mid-treatment.
Maybe they don't care in the White House or in the Governor's mansion, but that ache in your heart, that pit in your stomach, that's what reminds us we're all in this together, that we're not just one United States, we're one united people. E pluribus unum: out of many, one. That we're bound together by the same great national spirit that passed civil rights laws, defeated fascism, and landed men on the moon.
The United States is still destined for greatness, but only united will we meet the challenges and seize the opportunities of our time: to guarantee great health care for every American, to unleash an affordable housing boom and save our family farms, to harness new technologies for the good of the many and not the few, to make America the world leader on human rights and return nations to the path of peaceful coexistence.
And see, this is what small men like Donald Trump and J.D. Vance and Stephen Miller will never understand: That our national greatness flows not through our blood or our genes, but through our ideas. Americans are not a race, we're a people, united not by ethnicity, but by our shared convictions, and that is what makes us exceptional and a beacon to the world.

And Atlanta, a wave is building, the kind of wave that comes once a generation, when people have been pushed too far, and they decide all at once, all together, that enough is enough.
So let's give them a United Georgia.
Let's save the country again.
Let's make sure they hear it all the way down at Mar-a-Lago, that Georgia will bow to no king.
Thank you. God bless you. Let's get to work.

clean_body: We need 40 more volunteers to hit our 400 GOTV shift goal !!️ | | | | Hi folks, This is our final Monday before San Francisco votes, so I wanted to send you one last email heading into Election Day tomorrow. The political establishment never thought we'd get this far. They didn't think a campaign powered by volunteers and every day people could compete with special interests and the political machine. They didn't think thousands of people would show up to knock doors, make calls, host events, and build the largest grassroots field operation this city has ever seen. But that's exactly what happened. And now, in the final days, the special interests are panicking. This weekend, news broke that a confirmed AIPAC front group created a last-minute “pop-up” PAC to flood money into this race for one purpose: to keep Saikat out of Congress and keep voters in the dark until after ballots are cast. They’re doing this because Saikat has been clear from the start: we must end the genocide in Gaza, stop sending weapons to Israel, and build a foreign policy rooted in human rights — not lobbyist money. Saikat put it plainly: “As voters head to the polls this Tuesday, let’s send a strong message to AIPAC: stay the hell out of San Francisco.” I've had a front-row seat to this campaign from day one, and I've watched ordinary people do extraordinary things because they believe San Francisco deserves new leadership in Congress and from the Democratic Party. Now, we're just days away from making history. Last week, we set a goal of 400 volunteers on Election Day. As I write this, we're just 40 signups away. If you're outside the Bay Area, join one of our virtual phone banks and help us reach voters in these final days. We're incredibly close to our goal, team. Let's show the special interests, political insiders, and naysayers what people power looks like. \- Emily Emily Hyden Campaign Manager Saikat for Congress P.S. Hi there,

This is a reminder that California’s June primary is**Tuedsay, June 2** – which means you only have one more day to make your voice heard at the ballot box.

If you have not yet voted, you have options:
* **[Return your ballot to any drop-box or voting location](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132523046/624795423/775848546?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTE0ZjljZi0wNjVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hzDn5oXX07ZpOuJbynzcY--W1iWk0MCxged4hUhX2Pg=&emci=a45ed8f1-975b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=9114f9cf-065e-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=36327723) by 8pm on June 2**
* **[Vote in-person at a polling place.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132523047/624795424/775848546?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTE0ZjljZi0wNjVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hzDn5oXX07ZpOuJbynzcY--W1iWk0MCxged4hUhX2Pg=&emci=a45ed8f1-975b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=9114f9cf-065e-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=36327723)** Polling places are open 7am-8pm on election day.
* Even if you are not registered to vote, you may complete same-day voter registration at any in-person voting location within your county

If you have already voted, **[you can track the status of your ballot here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132523048/624795425/775848546?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTE0ZjljZi0wNjVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hzDn5oXX07ZpOuJbynzcY--W1iWk0MCxged4hUhX2Pg=&emci=a45ed8f1-975b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=9114f9cf-065e-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=36327723)**

Elections are the lifeblood of our democracy – and your participation is a crucial component in ensuring our government reflects the will of the people.

Please make a plan to get your ballot returned as soon as possible.

Gratefully,

-Team Weber

Hi folks,

Ballots for our state’s June primary are arriving by mail – and I want to encourage all of you to return your ballot as soon as possible.

**_[If you have any questions about how to cast your vote in the June primary, you can find up-to-date information here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132523049/624795426/-641415224?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTE0ZjljZi0wNjVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hzDn5oXX07ZpOuJbynzcY--W1iWk0MCxged4hUhX2Pg=&emci=a45ed8f1-975b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=9114f9cf-065e-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=36327723)_** [Learn more »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132523050/624795427/-641415224?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTE0ZjljZi0wNjVlLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExODkwNWMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hzDn5oXX07ZpOuJbynzcY--W1iWk0MCxged4hUhX2Pg=&emci=a45ed8f1-975b-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&emdi=9114f9cf-065e-f111-8fcb-000d3a18905c&ceid=36327723) My own grandparents were never able to vote, having lived their lives in the Jim Crow South. My parents were only able to cast their ballot when we moved to California.

Today, we see many people in power fighting to reinstate the very systems that have disenfranchised Black Americans for generations.

**If your vote did not matter, they would not be fighting so damn hard to take it away.**

The ballot box represents something bigger than any single election or issue: It is the hard-won result of generations of struggle — and a reminder that the fight to be heard is never truly finished.

I hope that you will take the time to exercise your rights and make your voice heard in this election.

Onward,

-Dr. Shirley N. Weber

body:
We’re focused on districts where Latino voters can decide the outcome.
#
Tomorrow is California’s primary election, Peter.
Millions of California voters have already cast their ballots, and right now we’re mobilizing people who haven’t voted in this crucial election. But we’re going to need extra resources in the next 24 hours to make that possible.
**[Rush in a $3 right now to help power our mobilization and voter registration efforts in California before tomorrow’s primary election →](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260601-1-ak.DGQl-M&amount=3&refcode=em20260601-199&t=1&akid=199%2E1366028%2E5EFEzA)**
**[Rush a Donation](https://act.votolatino.org/go/305?c0=em-ms-voto-20260601-1-ak.wHcoHX&refcode=20260601-199&t=2&akid=199%2E1366028%2E5EFEzA)**
Last year, California passed Proposition 50 to fight back after Trump and Texas Governor Greg Abbott succeeded in redrawing maps mid-decade.
It was a move to keep Republicans from locking in an advantage through gerrymandering, because even a few extra seats can be the difference in Democrats' ability to win back the House.
Prop 50 was designed to put more seats in play for Democrats. But after the Supreme Court weakened the Voting Rights Act and gave Republicans leeway to dilute representation, there is no margin for error in the November election.
_**Every flippable California seat now matters to Democrats’ path to retaking the House.**_
That is why we are focusing on two of the most competitive districts in California, currently held by Republicans, where Latino voters can decide the outcome and flip the House.
The only way we flip seats is if Latino voters are registered, informed, and turning out, which is exactly what we’re doing right now — meeting people where they are, running voter mobilization through Election Day, and turning registration into turnout.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.01_Luria-Chutzpah_B4_F1_S17_C17_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=4&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5) Peter, it’s Elaine Luria, and Blue Amp Action said I could reach out because it’s a pivotal moment for our campaign. The Virginia Supreme Court just struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed last month. [**So, our race just became even more crucial to our battle for the House Majority. Before I get into my background and how I’m fighting back, will you split a $25 donation to flip VA-02?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.01_Luria-Chutzpah_B4_F1_S17_C17_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=5&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5) | [DONATE $25](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.01_Luria-Chutzpah_B4_F1_S17_C17_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=6&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5)
---
_Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._
In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama.
That took some serious _chutzpah._
My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind.
That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community.
That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed.
In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms.
In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them.
In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous.
In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened.
In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them.
The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.**
Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.**
Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need.
[**Will you split a $25 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to help me win this battleground race and restore America’s promise for ALL?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.01_Luria-Chutzpah_B4_F1_S17_C17_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=7&akid=2401%2E259176%2EARTgc5)

| Personal note I need you to read this. | | Deadline June 2 The cutoff
---

Friend, Don't skim it. Don't save it for later. **Read it now.**
| | Tomorrow is the cutoff After that, this race moves on — with us or without us.
---|---
If we fall short now, Democrats get exactly what they want: this campaign stopped before November, before they ever have to defend their record one-on-one. I am not prepared to let that happen.
|
---
We are close. The momentum is real. But close does not get us into November. Resources do. Voter contact does. The final push does.
| Final stretch And right now, every hour matters.

This is it, Peter. Tomorrow, ballots are counted in CA-22 — and I wanted to take a moment before the big day to give you one last update. **But more than anything, I'm writing to say thank you.** This campaign would not have been possible without you. Whether you contributed, volunteered, knocked on a door, made a call, or just told a friend or neighbor about what we're building here — it all adds up. I am genuinely humbled to have you in this fight with me. I got into this race because I believe the Central Valley deserves better. Better than politicians who make promises they never keep. Better than a Congress that answers to corporate PACs and special interests instead of working families. Better than decades of being sold out by people who have never had to stretch a dollar in their lives. I grew up here — the son of Mexican immigrants, working weekends at the swap meet and my dad's auto shop, sharing a bunk bed in the living room with my brothers. I was the first in my family to go to college. I became a professor, a school board trustee, and a husband. This Valley made me who I am. I know what's at stake for the families here — because I came from one. And tomorrow we find out what this campaign adds up to. **[We're in a strong position heading into the big day, but I have one last question before the polls close: Will you make a final contribution to power our get out the vote effort through tomorrow at 8:00 PM? Muslim Michigan Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed has shamelessly launched a new coalition for his campaign called "Jews for Abdul." The first "Jews for Abdul" in-person event went exactly as one would expect, with Abdul launching into another antisemitic rant, this time telling his Jewish crowd that he was "struggling" with whether Israel has the right to exist. Sayed has built quite a lengthy resume of Jew-hatred as he has campaigned with rabid Jew-haters Hasan Piker and Rep. Summer Lee, who, in Sayed's presence, bragged about not condemning the October 7th Hamas terrorist attacks that murdered 1,200 Israelis and US citizens.
While speaking last week at his first "Jews for Abdul" event in Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed told the small Jewish crowd that he struggles with the question of Israel's existence:
_" I often struggle with the question that people ask in this particular scenario, because what they now ask is, 'Do you believe in Israel's right to exist as a Jewish state?'"_
Sayed's speech became more deranged as he questioned how Israel could be a democracy before explaining to the crowd that there are different types of "Jews", and asking how you sustain democracy if you don't have a Jewish majority? He also asked if there are particular offices that need to be held by certain types of Jewish people?
El-Sayed's new "Jews for Abdul" webpage calls on Jews to provide him with their contact information and zip code. It then reads:
_" Abdul's election to the United States Senate would be advantageous for all, including for Jews, because of his strong opposition to antisemitism and all forms of bigotry."_
The "Jews for Abdul" [webpage](https://substack.com/redirect/6e371ac6-224c-44d7-b7bd-5ddd5c2c8efc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) also states that President Trump's administration is helping Israel commit genocide in Gaza. The website says,
_" Abdul has properly characterized Israel's U.S.-enabled genocide in Gaza to be among the most immoral events of our time, tragic for both Israel and the United States."_
